verdict.rationale: Kimi is itself an AI assistant and offers task delegation in several places. The kimi.com prompt invites users to "do an Agent task." The help center lists an agent mode with Agent clusters, agent-built webpages, deep research, a PPT assistant and scheduled tasks. Kimi Code Desktop, the CLI and the editor sidebar let the agent read code, edit files, run commands and complete development tasks on its own. Community reports confirm people use it as a planning and coding assistant, though some find execution unreliable (excessive codebase grepping, then broken code). missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the consumer agent mode beyond help-center titles (limits, task scope, the Agent clusters feature), and independent hands-on confirmation that delegated tasks complete reliably.
